channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: American warship begins patrol of European waters
item.description: A United States Navy destroyer has begun a fresh patrol of European waters after departing the Spanish port of Las Palmas as part of a scheduled deployment with U.S. Sixth Fleet. The post American warship begins patrol of European waters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO chief warns Europe cannot defend itself without US
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has dismissed calls for a standalone European defence force, warning that Europe cannot defend itself without the United States and that attempts to go it alone would only weaken collective security. The post NATO chief warns Europe cannot defend itself without US first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Future of BATUS training use tied to defence investment plan
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the future scale of British Army activity at its major training facility in Canada will depend on the outcome of the forthcoming Defence Investment Plan. The post Future of BATUS training use tied to defence investment plan first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO forces in major build-up in Germany ahead of drills
item.description: NATO has begun a large-scale military build-up in Germany as allied forces and equipment arrive for Exercise STEADFAST DART 2026, the biggest exercise of the year and the first full test of its new Allied Reaction Force. The post NATO forces in major build-up in Germany ahead of drills first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD ties shipbuilding policy to new maritime strategy
item.description: "The forthcoming Shipbuilding and Maritime Technology Action Plan will describe the new approach to oversight of ship and boatbuilding programmes across the strategic breadth of Government procurement". The post MOD ties shipbuilding policy to new maritime strategy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain launches new Goshawk interceptor project
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has launched a new competition to develop a low-cost interceptor intended to counter drones, loitering munitions and missiles at close range with up to 7,000 produced per year. The post Britain launches new Goshawk interceptor project first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Armed British nuclear submarine sets sail
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has unusually confirmed the movement of an armed Royal Navy hunter-killer submarine, posting imagery of the vessel departing Gibraltar in what appears to be a deliberate act of strategic signalling. The post Armed British nuclear submarine sets sail first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence Secretary says Ajax must be backed or scrapped
item.description: The Defence Secretary has said the troubled Ajax armoured vehicle programme must now be either fully rescued or cancelled, admitting that ministers were not given the full facts before key decisions were taken. The post Defence Secretary says Ajax must be backed or scrapped first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British frigates could be armed with laser weapons
item.description: The DragonFire laser weapon may be deployed across a wider range of warships than previously confirmed. The post British frigates could be armed with laser weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Type 83 destroyer programme placed under Hybrid Navy review
item.description: The government has confirmed the future Type 83 destroyer is under review against the Hybrid Navy strategy which combines crewed and uncrewed platforms. The post Type 83 destroyer programme placed under Hybrid Navy review first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
